season_notes.text: Mysore has a tropical savanna climate with three main seasons - summer (March to May), the monsoon (June to October), and winter (November to February).

days.title: Arrival in Mysuru & Royal Heritage
notes: Enjoy a smooth drive via the Bengaluru-Mysuru Expressway.
Mysore Palace is beautifully illuminated on Sundays and public holidays, but the daytime tour is highly detailed and great for kids.

days.title: Wildlife, Nature & Illuminated Gardens
notes: The Zoo is highly engaging for kids. Electric carts are available inside for comfortable mobility.
Karanji Lake features India's largest walk-through aviary.
Brindavan Gardens' musical fountain show starts around 18:30.

days.title: Cathedral, Sand Art & Return to Bengaluru
notes: St. Philomena's Cathedral is one of the tallest churches in Asia.
The Sand Sculpture Museum is unique and highly fascinating for young kids.

warnings: Mysore Zoo is closed on Tuesdays, but your visit is planned for Saturday, so it is open.
Ensure to carry light jackets for the kids as evenings can get slightly chilly in December.

season_notes.text: December is one of the best times to visit Mysuru, offering pleasant weather with cool evenings, perfect for sightseeing.

plan.transport_reason: A private AC cab is recommended for a family with young kids to ensure maximum comfort, flexibility, and easy transfers between attractions.

days.title: Journey to Mysuru & Palace Splendour
notes: Travel via the Bengaluru-Mysuru Expressway in a comfortable private AC sedan.
At Mysore Palace, request a battery-operated golf cart at the entrance to avoid long walks.

days.title: Zoo Battery-Cart Tour & Royal High Tea
notes: Pre-book a battery-operated vehicle at Mysore Zoo to enjoy the wildlife without walking.
Enjoy a relaxed, royal vegetarian high tea at the iconic Lalitha Mahal Palace.

days.title: Srirangapatna Heritage & Return
notes: The temple has a direct drop-off point close to the entrance. Opt for Special Darshan tickets to minimize standing time.

warnings: Ensure battery-operated carts at Mysore Zoo are booked online in advance as they are in high demand.
Wheelchairs are available at Mysore Palace; ask the staff at the entrance gate.

season_notes.text: December offers pleasant, cool weather ideal for senior citizens to explore without exhaustion.

plan.transport_reason: A private AC sedan is recommended for the entire trip to ensure maximum comfort, step-free transfers, and to strictly adhere to the 3-hour daily travel limit.

days.title: Arrival & Royal Heritage of Mysuru
notes: Took an early morning budget train from Bengaluru to maximize time.
Explored the grand Mysore Palace and nearby historical spots on foot/auto.

days.title: Hills, Wildlife & Illuminated Gardens
notes: Used local KSRTC buses to reach Chamundi Hills and Brindavan Gardens to save money.
Enjoyed the evening musical fountain show at Brindavan Gardens.

days.title: Srirangapatna Ruins & Return
notes: Srirangapatna is on the way back to Bengaluru, making it an easy stopover.
Boarded the return train directly from Srirangapatna station to Bengaluru.

warnings: Ensure you book train tickets in advance as the Bengaluru-Mysuru route is highly frequented on weekends.
Brindavan Gardens can get very crowded on Saturday evenings; keep track of your belongings.
